# ADR-3233: AWS secrets: Hardcoded AWS access key in source for app 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Committed keys are harvested by scanners within minutes.

## Decision

Repositories MUST NOT contain a hardcoded AWS access key in source for app 1 (AWS-secrets-1).

## Consequences

Secrets scanners gate merges.
